answer: Each agent must periodically submit a unique proof-of-work nonce whose hash is bound to a hardware-attested key, creating an unforgeable identity crystal that cannot be cloned across nodes. Peers verify this attestation and broadcast an echo of the registration to a distributed ledger, while a randomized opal challenge derived from epoch entropy forces every participant. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(k * S) capital forfeiture.
